name: tulpar-ui
description: Tulpar UI — Lit-based design system with Angular and Vue wrappers

scripts.dev:ng: pnpm build && pnpm --filter playground-ng exec ng cache clean && pnpm --parallel --filter @tulpar-ui/tokens --filter @tulpar-ui/core --filter @tulpar-ui/shell --filter @tulpar-ui/angular --filter playground-ng run dev
scripts.dev:vue: pnpm build && pnpm --parallel --filter @tulpar-ui/tokens --filter @tulpar-ui/core --filter @tulpar-ui/shell --filter @tulpar-ui/vue --filter playground-vue run dev
scripts.dev:storybook: pnpm build && pnpm --parallel --filter @tulpar-ui/tokens --filter @tulpar-ui/core --filter @tulpar-ui/shell --filter docs run dev
scripts.dev: pnpm build && pnpm --filter playground-ng exec ng cache clean && pnpm --parallel --filter @tulpar-ui/tokens --filter @tulpar-ui/core --filter @tulpar-ui/shell --filter @tulpar-ui/angular --filter @tulpar-ui/vue --filter playground-ng --filter playground-vue --filter docs run dev
